findings.text: follow-on: `assert endpoint["accelerator_family"] == "H200"` compares the document's endpoint family against the family the test itself supplies -- the record is built as ServeRegistration(..., "H200", ...) and the catalog is _catalog("glm-5.3", "H200", 4, "int4"), so the endpoint entry echoes the test's own input through imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:432; the assertion holds whatever the publish code does as long as it copies the registration's family, and would not catch a regression that promoted a server-side default onto the endpoint. It is a control for the sibling assertion at tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:290 rather than a guard in its own right; that sibling (`assert server["accelerator_family"] is None`, against the literal None) is independent of the change. Non-blocking because the durability of this window rests on the independent assertion, not on this one.
